pets: clarify the Appetite stat tooltip. 'Appetite' is dual-purpose — the HATCHED gene value prices food (feedBlocks = value/(appetite*FEED_DIV), locked forever), and as a battle stat it's 'bulk & bite' (+HP, +damage). Training Appetite only grows the trained bonus + power (which feed battle), never the frozen on-chain ap that prices food — so it's free muscle with no bigger food bill. The old tooltip ('also sets food cost') read like training it would make the pet eat more; reworded to say food cost is fixed at hatch and training is free upside. Display-string only, no stat/gene math touched

chess: Flip board now works for BLACK too. The orientation was 'flipBoard || side===b' — an OR that pinned black's board to the flipped view permanently, so a black player could never rotate to white's-eye view. Made it XOR (flipBoard !== isBlack): each side starts oriented to itself and the button genuinely inverts it either way

chess: 'Offer draw' is no longer a silent no-op. agree(3) always worked on-chain (contract only needs nn==2 & unsettled), but nothing surfaced the offer: after you offered, the button still said 'Offer draw' and your opponent saw no change, so it felt dead. Now the button reflects state — '½ Offer draw' → '½ Draw offered — waiting for opponent…' once you've offered, and when your OPPONENT offers it flips to a pulsing '🤝 Accept draw — refund both stakes' plus a one-time banner. games UX: (1) STICKY INVITES — a followed share-link's join now survives the deposit round-trip instead of being consumed on the first return; the SDK keeps the invite until the join actually commits and auto-fires it the moment the deposit lands (exec balance rises), so poker/chess/tictactoe seat you automatically instead of dumping you back in the lobby to hunt for the table. (2) NO MORE STALE GREEN STATUS — chess had NO confirmation watch at all ('Move submitted…', 'Resigning…', 'Cancelling…' hung forever); added the poker/tictactoe-style on-chain resolve for every action, plus a 75s graceful-timeout fallback on all three so a never-landing tx can't stick. (3) PULSING JOIN CTAs everywhere — chess & tictactoe referenced a .pulse class that was never defined (so it did nothing); added the keyframes and pulse the Sit-down/Join buttons in poker, chess, tictactoe, and coinflip's active-game join
